IDF: Weapons and a children’s room bearing symbols associated with the Hezbollah terrorist organization found in a civilian home: Activities of the 769th Brigade in the Security Zone

Troops of the 769th Brigade, under the command of the 91st Division, are operating in the Security Zone in southern Lebanon to remove threats to Israeli civilians.

The Brigade’s troops are operating to dismantle terrorist infrastructure sites in the area of Al-Khiam.

As part of searches in the area, troops located weapons inside a civilian home, as well as a children’s room bearing symbols associated with the Hezbollah terrorist organization.

In addition, the troops located and dismantled an explosive drone storage facility and found additional weapons, including rockets, Kalashnikov rifles, helmets, vests, ammunition, and explosive drones.

The IDF will not allow the Hezbollah terrorist organization to harm Israeli civilians or IDF troops. The IDF will continue to operate to remove threats and remains committed to the ceasefire agreement.

Attached is footage of a children’s room bearing symbols associated with the Hezbollah terrorist organization: https://bit.ly/3W20r2B

Attached are photos of the weapons located inside the civilian residence and in the Security Zone in southern Lebanon: https://IDFANC.activetrail.biz/ANC1025202656789

Lebanon's health ministry confirms that one person was killed and another was wounded in an Israeli drone strike on a motorcycle in the town of Qabrikha in the country's south this afternoon.

IDF: During the 188th Brigade’s operations: More than 340 Hezbollah weapons located in the Security Zone in southern Lebanon

Troops of the 188th Brigade, under the command of the 36th Division, are operating in the Beaufort Ridge and Litani River areas in order to remove threats to Israeli civilians, following approximately one year and eight months of operations in the Gaza Strip and a period of extensive training.

During their activities, the troops located more than 340 weapons, including RPG rockets, anti-tank missiles, mortar shells, small arms, explosive devices, grenades, and ammunition.

In addition, an approximately seven-meter-deep underground shaft was located inside a civilian home. Medical and living equipment was found inside.

The IDF will not allow the Hezbollah terrorist organization to harm Israeli civilians or IDF troops. The IDF will continue to operate to remove threats and remains committed to the ceasefire agreement.
